t: Talk to Fiercetusk the Roughneck in Izune.

Okay, listen up but don't look at me. Pretend we don't know each other. I have some very important information for you!
Fiercetusk the Roughneck has outgrown Izune and wants to get his paws on the Astral Quarter, the neighboring area. Squall and his boys are based there and they're not going to lie down without a fight.
To make matters worse, Fiercetusk the Roughneck is a fighter, while Squall is a shaman. They have some sort of ideological dispute, but I'm not too clued up on that sort of thing. What I do know is that Fiercetusk's boys have got their hands on some weapons and are planning to make a move for the Astral Quarter.
They've also gotten their hands on some mysterious amulets. I don't know what they do because the Orcs only issue them to a select few.
Here's where it gets complicated - you need to earn their trust and get them to give you an amulet. I suggest you start at the arena. Orcs respect brute strength like nothing else. I'd do it myself, but just look at my nonexistent muscles! Anyway, this conversation never happened. Goodbye.

I haven't seen your ugly mug before. What do you want?
What? You want to join us? Hah, and what makes you think you'd be good enough to get in? You're welcome to test your strength... my boys are going to have some fun with you!
Defeat 3 Orcish Duelists and report to Fiercetusk the Roughneck.

I tell you what, if you happen to defeat three of my boys, maybe I'll let you join our gang. But you do know that your useless head will go flying towards the Astral Quarter with one hit from my men, right? The goblins will make a good meal out of you, I'm sure. I'm looking forward to the entertainment!
Well, what are you waiting for? Go in there and let me see what you're worth. Don't tell me you're running away already!

Yes, I didn't expect that! I really didn't! Well, we need new members. And non-members, too. Hah!

But the fact that you knocked my guys out does not make you one of us. Prove that you are willing to help the Orcs! Look, those are Strongarm the Rowdy and Muscles the Unyielding over there. They are honorary warriors and veterans of the clan. Help them, and then we'll talk.
Take the Mysterious Amulet to Vera Chonkina at the Astral Quarter.

What a strange thing... You should probably take it to the Guardian.

It might help us figure out the connection between the Hadron Quarter and the Orcish clans.
Was it difficult to get the amulet? It looks like you've got your fair share of bruises, but at least you're still in one piece.

I've got no idea what this is or what it does. It must be sent to our scientists for examination immediately.

The Arisen are planning something. Why can't they just live peacefully...? The Empire has created a perfect environment for all its citizens. Some people are just too dumb to appreciate it! Or too smart...
Kill 4 Monstrous City Termites in the northern part of Izune and report to Oxana Mizina, the Guardian of the Fourth Nezeb Memorial.

"... And the cities of the Xadaganians flourished, their fields overflowed with golden grain, and the beautiful voices of their children filled the air, but the barbarous Kanians continued to forge weapons and learn spells of destruction. It was then that the great Nezeb opened his heart to sacred love and chose the strong, brave, and loyal Orcs to join forces with the Xadaganian people in an eternal alliance against the Kanian threat. And so the great Nezeb assigned a Great Mage to the Orcs so they could live on their own allod, and their shamans spilled tears of joy for many moons."
Termites from the prairie have recently invaded northern Nezebgrad. They pose a great threat to the Orcish population of Izune. Especially for Izune City which was named after the main allods of the Orcs! Your task is to kill four termites to honor the heroic act of the great Nezeb and the alliance between the Xadaganian people and the Orcs.
Talk is cheap - you must prove your ideals with action!
You have completed your pilgrimage! Congratulations. The Fifth Memorial is not complete yet, but when you have time, go visit Oxana Mizina, the Guardian at the Victory Park.
Obtain 4 pieces of Termite Meat for Muscles the Unyielding in Izune. You can find the Termites in the northern part of the Orcish district.

One, two, three, four! One, two, three, four! Why are you wrinkling your nose? Do I smell? Look at my triceps! Touch it, come on! You don't want to? Your loss!
Even the Xadaganians can't take their eyes off me, let alone the Orcs! They admire my looks, that's why! What else? One, two, three, four! You have to love your body and take care of it, you know! Actually, you can stop staring and help me.
I've run out of protein and the clan's store has been shut down - they had some tax issues or something.
One orc told me that termite meat is rich in protein - it would make a great meal. Can you get eight pieces for me? The north has recently been overrun by termites. I bet you could get some great chunks of meat off of them.
The quality of protein from the clan's store has been dropping lately anyway. They probably started mixing it with some disgusting additives, so it's time to switch to a natural diet!
Just put it down over there. Thanks a bunch! I suggest you move away now, I'm going to start on my leg exercises. One, two, three, four...
Bring 3 Concrete Slabs to Strongarm the Rowdy.

Fighting in the arena is so last century. It's pointless self-injury.
Us Orcs need to get with the times. Once you build yourself the perfect body, you go on the stage of a big stadium and receive ovation after ovation. Your body is illuminated by torches and you pose, flex your muscles like this, and like this, and everyone loves you! That's my dream!
I still have a lot of work before I can do something like that, but perseverance is something the great Nezeb taught us. Or was it patience? You don't remember by any chance? Well, it doesn't matter. Anyway, I have a problem with my barbells. I don't use the standard versions - they're way too light. Instead, I figured out a way to use slabs of concrete. The only problem with the slabs is that they crumble pretty quickly.
Here, take this potion. Put it away! It's illegal to possess this stuff. Run to the construction site in northern Izune and bring me two... no, three slabs. The potion will increase your strength so they'll feel as light as a feather! So drink it first, then grab the slabs and come back here.
Don't even think about using the potion for anything else! If I find out that you've abused your powers, you'll feel the wrath of the Izune Orcs!
Oh, thank you! Time to get back to my training. I'll be sure to mention you in my acceptance speech when I win my first contest.
Pass the Test of Strength and report your success to Wire the Wily.

Halt! A recruit? Then listen up! You are just a nobody. And no orc will call you a friend. And that won't change until you complete our challenge. It's Squall's order - he's our shaman.

See the totem behind me? It summons a spirit. You need to defeat it.

I must warn you: there could be more than one. But it has never happened before. But maybe you'll get lucky, ha ha!

So let's get this over with. Be quick about it. We've been getting recruits from all over the Empire, there are too many of you.

And if I see you sticking around even though you haven't completed the challenge, I'll know you're a coward who can't be trusted!
Well? Have you finished it yet? Or are you still thinking about going back to where you came from?

Looks like you're still in one piece. The spirit wasn't alone? Four of them you say?
No, I wasn't lying, there was only supposed to be one. How could that have happened?
Meet Wire the Wily at the Astral Quarter gates
If you want to talk to the orcs as a peer, you have to earn our trust first. Go find Wire the Wily, our shaman, she will assign you a proper trial.
Who are you? What do you want?
Well? Why are you staring at me?
What? No, you are destined to find the descendant of the Legendary Orc, and that's it.
h: I think I'm the one you need!

t: What? No, you are destined to find the descendant of the Legendary Orc, and that's it.
h: I think I'm the one you need!

t: Ahaha! What are you babbling... There are no orc psionicists! Or rather, we have yet to find them. But you're definitely not one of them. You're just a weird shaman!
Talk to Squall the Unyielding in the Astral Quarter.

Squall the Unyielding warned me that this could happen one day. "The spirit won't arrive alone, and instead it will bring some friends with him..." Something like that.
Run go see Squall the Unyielding and tell him what happened. He should be in the central part of the Astral Quarter. Oh and don't worry, you're free to pass now.

So, more than one spirit appeared at once! I've waited for this to happen for many, many years.
The day has finally come! Let me take a closer look at you.
Bring 4 vials of Spider Blood to Squall the Unyielding.

We Orcs are viewed by others as a barbaric race, capable only of fistfights. It's wrong. For we have an aptitude for magic as well! The Orcs have huge potential. A long time ago, our tribe had its own Great Mage. He held our allod together as well as the human mages.

We call him the Legendary Orc. Unfortunately, all traces of him have vanished, but we will continue to search for his descendants until the end of our days! When I say "we", I mean the shamans and all of our loyal friends.

We have several leads. And one of them is you. Yes, you.

Our totem summons a hostile spirit which will fight any hostile newcomers. And if the spirit detects something special in the newcomer's blood, more spirits will show up to attack them. That's what the legend says. You are our hope now. Don't listen to anyone else. You have the greatest destiny in this world!

Wait, don't go yet. We need to contact the friendly spirits and ask them to guide you. We must summon them with the ancient Ritual of Blood. No, don't be scared. They won't attack you!

Bring me the blood of four spiders. Ordinary city ones will not work - they are too old. But the Gigantic Spiders near the Mana Station should be perfect.

We'll begin as soon as you bring the blood!
Spider blood is a very good reagent. It is dark and viscous and filled with hate and anger!
Ah, this is exactly what we need... I haven't performed the Blood Ritual in a long time, but I still remember the words. Let us begin!
Shut off the main valve of the Astral Quarter's mana pipes and report to Squall the Unyielding.

Curses! What the is going on?! The spirit has appeared but I can't hear him! Something must be interfering - but what could it be?
Of course! The Astral! The energy from the mana pipeline has ensnared the whole city and although we don't feel it, it's sucking out our lifeforce and poisoning the living. It's those damn Arisen and their science! I know that one day they will kill us all, mark my words!
I'm afraid we have no choice but to shut off the pipeline. The main thing is that the Council doesn't find out. You'll keep quiet, won't you?
You'll have to sneak around the mana pipes to the north and turn off the main valve for a short while. While you do that, I'll summon the spirit again and talk to him. We've waited for our Chosen One to appear for a long time, so don't let me down!

Don't worry about the valve - no one should find out. And if they do, I'll tell Wrokag the Northwind that you had a good reason. He's the leader of all the Orcs, you know. He reports to Yasker himself!
Everything is going perfectly! I managed to talk to the spirit, and now we can continue with our plans!
Resolve the situation with the XAES and inform Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker’s Tower.

So, the spirit has confirmed everything: you are destined to find the descendant of the Legendary Orc. You must inform Wrokag the Northwind. Go and tell him everything that happened here! Tell me you are the chosen one!

The eyes of all the Orcs are now fixed on you! Alright, not all the Orcs... There are some unbelievers in our tribe who gave up hope long ago. They claim that we do not need magic and that we are different from those prissy Elves. They prefer to play Goblinball and fight in the arenas. Fiercetusk the Roughneck's gang is made up of those renegades. And they call themselves warriors. How do you like them? A pitiful sight, as I'm sure you'll agree. The Orcs are becoming weak and lazy! But you and I? We will bring back the Legendary Orc!

Go talk to Wrokag. You can find him in Yasker’s Tower. But... he won't see you now anyway. They have some kind of emergency over there. The whole city is in uproar. I don’t know what happened, only that it has something to do with the central Mana Station, the XAES. Until it blows over, you won't be able to reach Wrokag.

Fate has chosen you.

The situation with the XAES has been resolved thanks to you. And you will help our people find the Legendary Orc. It has to be this way, because the legend says so.
Find the snitch in the Astral Quarter.

Have you seen a suspicious-looking fellow around here? The guy might as well have had the words "I'm a miserable cop informer" written on his forehead. No?
He said he'd just moved here from out of town, was registering for citizenship, had to wait for three days and blah blah blah. The thing is, one of our guys saw him at the City Council building when he was brought there for questioning. There's no way that fellow is a new citizen - he's a spy! I can tell you, he ain't gonna enjoy it when I find him...
By the way, if you see anyone who fits the description give them a nice hard nudge in the ribs and bring them to me.

How could my cover be blown by something as stupid as a chance meeting. The folks at the City Council need to work on concealing their spies and stop giving them office duties at the same time as a mission!
Collect 3 Partially-Digested Bones and take them to Strike the Wily.

I know you, you are the Imperial Survivor.  I think I can trust you.

Yes, I'm from the City Council. Just like the Imperial Sentinels, we are extremely concerned about what is happening in the most crime-infested residential districts. The bandits have made themselves right at home and smuggling is rife. I would even say that we're more concerned than the Imperial Sentinels. After all, the city's internal matters are within the Council's jurisdiction, and Yasker is not one to forgive mistakes.

I know the Council would really appreciate it if you would help me out here! Please?

I've already got a plan - I want to convince the bandits that I'm dead. There are giant spiders here in the Astral Quarter who are said to eat anything, even cats and dogs. Gather some bones from their cobwebs and show them to the bandits Tell them that's all that's left of the spy - that's me. Come back once you're done. I have important information for the Council, but with a "tail" like that, I won't be able to send it to them.
I'll squash that informer when I find him! I'll crush him with my bare hands!

Are you sure those are human bones? They look more like goblin bones, and a small goblin at that... Well, I suppose you wouldn't lie. Squall the Unyielding says you're the clan's Chosen One. Thanks for the information, now I have one less thing to worry about.
Take the "Pointy Ears" to Stas Propashin at the Victory Park.

So the ruse worked? This is good, now listen here: I did manage to get hold of one piece of evidence. Give it to our contact, the crippled beggar in Victory Park.

I recommend that you don't look at the evidence yourself. From what I hear, even the most disciplined and upstanding citizens will find themselves corrupted by this filth.

Thank you for assisting the authorities!

Well, let's get acquainted. I'm Stas Propashin, an agent of the City Council. Oh, how much we agents sacrifice for our nation!

What's this? Oh! A new issue! Don't worry, I'll pass this on to the right person immediately.
Speak with the criminals near the memorial in Victory Park.

The impossible has happened! This is a national emergency!

Nezeb's Staff has been stolen!

You see, a new memorial to Nezeb was supposed to be opened in Victory Park. It's a massive monument with figures of great warriors, and the cherry on top was supposed to be a statue of the great Nezeb with... yes, a staff in its hands. No, they didn't steal that one. If only! That one was made of stone! They stole the real one!

It was the only possession of his that was left behind following his disappearance! It's simply priceless! Heads will roll!

We must find that staff at any cost! That's our duty! Whoever dared to do this... we'll deal with them, that's for sure. Okay, you need to infiltrate the criminal world. I hear you've been hanging out with criminals, so keep an ear out and ask around to see if there are any rumors about the staff. Start in Victory Park: I doubt shamans or warriors were involved.

And don't say a word about this to anyone! Not a single living soul! Don't even discuss it in your dreams! Any disclosure of this information is punishable by death! This is the greatest state secret!

What are you looking at? You looking for trouble? I'll give you trouble! Oh, you don't like me and the boys chilling out by the memorial? You have a problem with that? Well, I don't think the boys like you very much either... isn't that right boys?! Let's teach this punk a lesson, fellas!
Find Yaver Krutch near the Sewage Plant.

Don't hit me! what the heck have I done...? I told you, I don't know anything. Are you even listening to me or what? I'm telling the truth!
If you want to find something out, go and see Yaver Krutch! That's who you need to talk to! He's got all the power around here!
Where is he? Near the Sewage Plant, of course. Just follow the smell and you'll find him. We've got a camp there, right on the southern edge of the place.
Well, what do you want? Yeah, the bastards locked me up. Never mind, once I get out I'll show them! Scumbags...
Retrieve Nezeb's Staff from the XAES and return it to Yasker himself.

Are you the Imperial Survivor? I know about you! Pravdin told me all about your heroic feats. Oh... I can't stop crying. How could it be? Someone stole Nezeb's Staff! Who would dare do that?
I just finished reading a beautiful essay about Nezeb's leadership in the Great Astral Campaign. And now this happens! Oh great Nezeb, where art thou? It feels like the whole world is falling down upon our heads...
There can only be one pilgrimage at a time like this - to return Nezeb's Staff. That wouldn't be a regular pilgrimage... that would be a real act of heroism! But you're not just an ordinary citizen either, you're the Imperial Survivor!
Do you have something to say? I am quite busy right now.

Well, many a pilgrim has defended Nezeb's memorials, but you're the only one who has truly repeated Nezeb's heroic act by protecting us from the Astral's destructive power. The Empire is in your debt. I never thought I'd say this to anyone but... I am in your debt too.
And you have finally completed your pilgrimage. I will personally give you the Fifth Mark of a Pilgrim. There has never been a citizen of the Empire who has been more worthy of it than you!
Take the Suspicious Kebab and 4 pieces of Hyena Meat to someone at the Sewage Plant.

Ewww! what the heck is this? Oh my, it's an ear! A hyena ear! In my kebab! I'm calling the police. They'll put those vendors behind bars for this!
It says here - "Consists of only the tender meat of Stompers organically raised in the pristine mountains of a remote northern allod". I don't think this is Stomper meat! If it is, then why does it smell of the local dump, huh? Answer me!
We'll get to the bottom of this, trust me on that! I work hard for my money and it was wasted on this?! Where are the police? Never around when you need them!
Maybe you can help me? Go collect some meat from a few hyenas. Bring it to the head of the Sewage Plant along with this kebab for comparison. He'll know what's what. We'll get to the bottom of this, that's for damn sure!
I'm tired of repeating myself - we have eradicated all of the bedbugs in the Astral Quarter! Oh, you're not here about the bedbugs? What do you want?... Is that a kebab?

So... what have we here? Hmm... no, this isn't Stomper meat. It really does match the hyena meat you collected. And what do you know, it's contaminated with the ecori virus.
I'll draw up a report on this issue and put it in this pile here. It'll be report 3567. It might even get looked at this year. Thank you for your vigilance! Wait a minute, take this reward and a certificate recognizing your assistance to the Empire.
Destroy 4 Inferno Elementals. Report to Dubi the Dirty.

The people here have no manners! They trample the grass, sing outrageous songs at all hours of the night, and throw trash straight onto the ground. I dream of the day they all walk along the paths in disciplined lines, singing official songs and throwing their trash into the bins.
But that's not the biggest of my worries right now. The city authorities decided to send us some domesticated fire elementals to help get rid of the trash. Some help! You know what they say about the road to hell...
In just three days, these elementals managed to incinerate three benches and two mobile toilets along with the trash they were supposed to be burning. Today they even started burning the trees down... this park will be a desert before too long. Help the city and destroy those damn monsters!
And to think we were trying to compete for the title of Park of the Year! After this elemental affair we've got no chance.
Thank you! Now we can start rebuilding the park. Feel free to choose one of these items as your reward. I can also give you this certificate officially recognizing your deeds.
Talk to Igor Pilkin in the Old Square.

I'll be honest with you. The Kanian attack was no accident. There is a rat somewhere at the heart of the Empire. We need to find them and make an example of them.
The Council has recently come up with a plan and your involvement is of the utmost important. You see, the results of Project Salvation are to be made public. Tomorrow the media and our propaganda services will spread the news that the portal was successfully tested.
The story will include your photo and the Imperial traitor will be bound to take an interest in you. That'll lead him right to us! By the way, you don't have a choice in this matter - this is an order! We all serve the Empire, each in our fashion.
For now, blend in with the crowd and try to become an ordinary citizen. Oh, by the way, all new arrivals to Nezebgrad must register with the Passport Official. I permit you to do this on a priority basis and skip the queue.

Calm down please, calm down! You'll all get your turn!
Quiet, woman, I can't hear anything! Where do you think you're going? Whose elbow is this? Oh, Major Pravdin sent you... Okay, I'll give you a quick summary of what's going on.
Meet with Rysk the Crafty near the Sewage Plant.

So listen here.

The Council is worried. Something bad is brewing in the country. The police are now involved with the bandits. For example, were you not surprised at Stepan Velikanin's reaction to Slouch's murder? Or that the capital has been swamped with prohibited literature right under Yasker's nose? The stuff is everywhere - Elven filth for the easily corruptible, and inaccurate historical studies for wise guys who like to express their political opinions over the kitchen table. And what about the way the Sentinels suppressed the investigations into those matters? Which brings us to the matter at hand.

Yes, unfortunately the Council suspects them of involvement. Aren't they the Fifth Column? By a whim of fate, you are at the very center of these events, and as a true citizen of the Empire you cannot refuse the demands of the Council. You must help bring our common enemy to justice. One of our agents is waiting for you by the sewage plant to the west. He will give you further instructions.

Did Stas Propashin send you?

I have some information for you.
Kill 4 Stinking Slugs and report to Stinky the Nimble.

And now we finally come to report 1347. This one is about the slugs near the Sewage Plant.
The plant workers are complaining that, while the slugs are small, they breed so quickly that they've eaten all the vegetation. More importantly, they produce so much slime that three Xadaganians and one Orc have had to go to hospital with broken limbs from slipping! Hm, this is a pretty old report.
I reckon those broken bones have been healed for more than a year now, but I doubt those slugs have left of their own will. Yeah, right. They've probably gotten bigger too. How about taking care of this for us? It says here "4 slugs". That's it!
The slugs are getting bigger, you say? Well, what do you want me to do? I'm just one person, I can't deal with everything at once.

Thanks for eliminating those slugs. Maybe the other workers will complain less now. I have a reward for your help. Choose anything you like. Oh, and take this certificate signifying your assistance in Imperial sanitation issues.
Paint 3 Mana Pipes and report to Semer Wadjmose.

Listen, we need a brave volunteer. We're expecting an inspection soon. Yasker plans to examine the mana pipes out here himself and our bosses want to make sure everything is picture perfect for his visit. At the Sewage Plant, of all places! They even want us to paint the mana pipes!
We've sent hundreds of requests for help but we've not been allocated any soldiers yet... damn those bureaucrats! Why do we need soldiers? This area is swarming with all sorts of nasty creatures - I'm not risking any of my workers! It took me a year to put a decent team together. I've got the best sanitizers in the land!
But I'm sure you could handle yourself out there! I recognize you, you're the Imperial Survivor - I read about you in the papers. So, here's a chance for you to go out there and live up to your name! There are a ton of pipes out there. They've been there for a long time, so they're all rusty by now. I'll give you a brush, a bucket, and some paint. You know what to do.
It's like workers need combat skills these days! How else will they be able to do their jobs?

You've already painted them, you say? You didn't just pour the paint onto the ground in a corner, did you?
Well, I guess I'll have to take your word for it. I hope you're not lying to me, Survivor!
Infiltrate the smugglers' camp near the Sewage Plant and deliver the evidence you find to Pavel Nevolin.

Yaver Krutch's boys are behind the contraband operation distributing that prohibited literature? Who would have thought that some dumb thugs would spark such a political controversy! Unthinkable!

I'm positive that none of those morons could have planned this themselves. Even Krutch is not the sharpest knife in the drawer. Someone else is behind this, and we need to find out who they are.

You must infiltrate their base. It shouldn't be far from here. If you find any evidence or documents, take them to Pavel Nevolin and give him my regards!
So, the smugglers' main base is near the Sewage Plant? Well, I suppose that's the perfect place for scum like them. Then again, they have no place at all here in the Empire!

Well, I guess it's time to introduce myself again. I am Pavel Nevolin, an agent of the City Council. And what do you have there? Some kind of document. In Elven! I sense a promotion coming my way, and it's about time. I'm getting tired of sitting around here!

I need to make sense of this. My Elven is getting rusty. Our Political Commissar kept telling me I should practice it more often! And I was too lazy... Anyway, I'll figure something out!
Talk to Oleg Pravdin in the Old Square.

Damn, I have paid for my short-sightedness! I wanted to increase my authority and expand my operations... That's the only reason I got involved with the smugglers. They even contacted me first, via goblins!
How could I have walked into such a trap? I didn't know what they were really up to, I swear! I only figured out something was wrong when the smugglers stole Nezeb's Staff. Some things are too sacred to be stolen.
It's the League's fault I tell you, the League is behind this! I had nothing to do with stealing that Staff, will you tell the Council that? Will you put in a good word for me? I'm an honest gangster! I'm for the Empire! The Empire is my home!

You look like you've got important news! Come on, spit it out!
Oh my!
So the League has Nezeb's Staff. That's the worst news I've had in...60 seconds! Before that I got some pretty terrible news as well... What is the world coming to?
Talk to Ilya Chernavin near the Boiler Camp.

Well, I've finally managed to plow my way through this pompous Elven verbosity.

It's the usual good news, bad news scenario. The bad news is that the League is involved in this conspiracy against the Empire, and their poison has done its work. They have a plan to sabotage our entire culture!  Just listen to what this Elven bastard says:

"... a totalitarian society like the Empire does not require a massive conspiracy involving the bribing of officials and the like. The hunger for information is so great that the citizens of the Empire are prepared to deceive themselves and betray their ideals just to satisfy it. Elven porn magazines make the Orcs forget about their wars, Zem scientists do not care where the data for their research comes from, and the Xadaganian women will sell their mother for a new dress pattern..." Can you believe this?!

The good news pales in comparison. It turns out we were wrong about the Sentinels - they are not involved in this conspiracy any more than the rest of us.

What's really interesting is the bit about the Staff! The dead Elf you got these papers from was upset about the upcoming operation! He says it's "neither the time nor the place". He said "this whole undertaking with the staff and the XAES may interfere with his cultural mission." It's a pity they didn't listen to him...

Well, we have other problems now. There's a national emergency. Yes, another one! The Xadaganian Astral Energy Station has been captured. My head is spinning. An emergency Council meeting has been formed at the base near the Boiler Camp. Go there, find the Council representative Ilya Chernavin, and tell him everything you know.

Yes?! Just don't tell me something else has happened! Hmm... So, the XAES being captured is related to the theft of Nezeb's Staff? But how?
Well, at the moment we need to leave this information for later and get to the job at hand.
Talk to Oko the Righteous near the Boiler Camp.

Just when you thought it couldn't get any worse it does! But no! There's no end to the bad news!

You would have thought nothing could be worse than the Staff being stolen, right? Nothing! Well, how about the enemy getting into a closed sector and infiltrating the XAES?!

That's right! The XAES has been captured! Naturally, the League is behind it. Nobody knows exactly what's going on, but it looks like the infiltration and the theft of the Staff are connected.

Go to the Boiler Camp immediately. Tell the City Council everything we've learned so far.

Nezeb's Staff? Why do they still need the Staff? Another mystery!

However, I also have news. They found a goblin with a Smuggler's Letter in the Hadron Quarter. They handed it over to us. We decrypted it.
Speak with Vera Chonkina to sign a nondisclosure agreement

There's another urgent matter.

Remember that amulet you had to fight for in Fiercetusk the Roughneck's arena? They've finished the tests on it but unfortunately I can't tell you anything.  Alas.

One of the scientists blabbed about it to someone else, and now the matter has been classified as 'top secret'. We've all had to sign a non-disclosure agreement. Except you. It's time to correct that.

This came right from the top, so you don't have a choice - sign it. Naturally, your discretion will be rewarded.

Disclose this to anyone and they'll put you away for life in the best case scenario!
Don't think, just sign it.
Perfect! You have a beautiful signature. And here's your reward.
Kill 4 League Operatives or League Spies and report to Ilya Chernavin.

The situation is as follows - the enemy has somehow infiltrated the XAES, captured the key points, and shut down the supply of magical energy to the city. Do you even understand how important this power plant is?!
 The Astral is supplied to the plant via the pipelines and then converted into magical energy. The magical energy is then pumped to the city where it gives the people light, heating, and hope for tomorrow. Without energy, people lose faith. Now you understand that the XAES is of great strategic importance.
We're going to storm it and smoke them out. But I don't want to rush things. We don't know what they want and how many of them are inside. It could be a trap... And there are too many League Operatives and Spies in the area.
You should go out and take care of them. Scout the Boiler Camp and slit some throats. Go, go. Your homeland is in danger!
To assault or not to assault, that is the question!
Well, that's one less task to worry about! The trouble is that while you were away, the number of problems has increased. Let me fill you in.
Find the entrance to the Ruined Catacombs in the Boiler Camp and report Oko the Righteous.

Every kindness you do to a goblin will be repaid with betrayal. We built a mighty civilization and a powerful country but forgot this simple truth that our ancestors knew so well!
What do I mean? Well, the goblin workers from the plant sold out the Empire! They joined forces with the Kanians and aided in their invasion. They also acted as the middlemen between the Kanians and Tep cultists.
What do Tep cultists have to do with this, you say? Well, we're not entirely sure ourselves, but they've been spotted around the Boiler Camp among the League troops. We suspect some catacombs have been discovered near the plant. They might even have an exit outside of Nezebgrad, allowing the League to travel through them and into our city.
You know, the Imperial Sentinels were against hiring the goblins, but Yasker listened to the Council which claimed that internal matters were within its jurisdiction. Now look where we ended up.
Anyway, we've got to get back to business. I don't care if you have to crawl over every inch of ground - you must find the entrance to the catacombs!

The battle draws nearer. We just need to find those catacombs and we can finish our scouting operations.
As soon as we do, I'll be the first to rush forth with Nezeb's name on my lips!

Good job! If it weren't for my orders, I'd be rushing over there right now!
But discipline is key. Discipline will lead the Empire to victory. You also need courage, and that's something you seem to have in abundance soldier!
Meet Natalia Suvorina, Guardian of the First Nezeb Memorial at the Old Square, to learn more about the pilgrimage.

All new arrivals to the heart of our great, powerful, and eternal Empire must prove... quiet down, people!... must prove their allegiance to Nezeb! There are five memorials in the city which commemorate the great deeds of the great Nezeb.
Simply visiting them is not enough, however! You must personally connect with the experience of the great Nezeb, and take at least one step down his path in an attempt to imitate his heroism.
The memorial guardians will provide further details. Once you have visited each memorial and collected five Marks of a Pilgrim come back for your registration. And remember, until you're registered you can only stay in the city for three days! Next!
There are five memorials to Nezeb in the city. Well, technically there are only four open one to the public, but there's a fifth scheduled to open soon. They all must be visited.

Welcome, pilgrim! Do you want to get an insight to our ancient traditions, stand in awe of our Great Leader's deeds, learn about the losses he suffered for the sake of our nation? Then listen carefully.
Place a Bundle of Flowers at all five of the Nezeb Memorials and return to Igor Pilkin.

Commemorating the great deeds of Nezeb once is not enough! We must continue to show our respect and keep him close to our hearts. We owe all that we have to him!
Place these flowers at each of his five memorials and report to me once you're done. And remember, the deeds of outstanding citizens will not go unrewarded.
Have you visited all of the memorials yet?
How nice it is to have upstanding citizens like you in our great city. Take this as a reward, and remember to never let Nezeb stray far from your thoughts!
Kill the City Crows and report back to Natalia Suvorina, the Guardian of the First Nezeb Memorial near the City Council.

"...And when Nezeb was defeated in the duel of the Great Mages, he was banished to the arid desert. The earth was blessed, for he became the leader of a people.

The Xadaganians had wandered between wind-swept dunes in rusty wagons, our wives' hands bleeding and our children crying sand instead of tears. Sandstorms and vicious jackals took many lives, but we did not abandon hope. An ancient prophecy foretold that a messenger from above would descend upon the golden sands to lead the people to a new era. And so the Great Nezeb descended and became our leader.

But the trials of our people were not over. One day the Xadaganians found their path blocked by monstrous Aviaks. Their wings blotted out the sun and the skies became dark. Their terrible croaks filled the desert, and husbands could not even hear their wives' parting words. It was then that the Great Nezeb opened his heart to holy wrath and committed the first of his heroic acts. He did this for us, his people. The Aviaks vanished without a trace. And so the Xadaganians continued their journey to greatness."

You now have to repeat Nezeb's heroic act. Fortunately, there are no Aviaks here but we do have crows. Think of Nezeb and kill four of them in his name. They are especially numerous along the borders of the Old Square.

The crows are worse than the Aviaks! Those disgusting birds defile the memorial. I have to clean it every day.

Oh, great Nezeb! Why did I do to get stuck with this memorial?!
Congratulations! You have completed your pilgrimage! Hopefully I'll have less to do now. Go speak with Yana Vezirova at the Bort Quarter.
Read the radiation level of 6 Mutant Rats and report to Sarang Ahhotep.

I am a scientist sent by the ZIT to collaborate with the City Council during this emergency. The XAES is one of the greatest achievements of the ZIT, so it's no surprise that what happens to it is of great concern to us.
In addition to that, the situation created by the League's sabotage is a unique one. The local rats have been under the influence of the Astral for a long time. At the moment, the supply of Astral energy has stopped since the plant is currently inactive. We need to measure their radiation levels to see if they've dropped at all during this crisis. My hypothesis is that the rats are now permanently affected by the Astral radiation, and there shall be no change. Do you think you can take the measurements for me?
Nothing must be allowed to stand in the way of science, you know. Not even League saboteurs! The Empire's power is based on science and progress! Now take this dosimeter and use it to measure the radiation level of six different rats.
Help with science today and it'll save you tomorrow. I would have thought that was obvious.
Thanks for your help. I'll send the data out to be analyzed immediately!
Defuse the 6 Astral Mines and report to Crazystorm the Merciless, the leader of the Imperial Sentinels.

This debacle is approaching its conclusion. The saboteurs are threatening to blow up the XAES if we don't meet their demands. They must be prevented from doing this - by you. Are you the Imperial Survivor or what? Right now you'll have to survive again, for we don't have any other choice.
You will infiltrate the power plant via the ancient Zem catacombs. Once you're inside, locate the 6 Astral Mines the saboteurs have set. Defuse them and then come back. You can report your success directly to Crazystorm the Merciless, the leader of the Imperial Sentinels.
I don't need to tell you how important this mission is. You know what the power plant means to the entire Empire. And I'm pretty sure that this will look great on your resume, so get over there and get it done!

There is no task more important than resolving the crisis at the power plant... Argh! Damn this job! What I really want to do is storm into the plant myself, eliminate those Kanian bastards, and defuse those damn mines!
Let me give you a good pat on the back, soldier! People like you are the backbone of the Empire! Hurray! Glory and honor to the hero!
Collect the Mysterious Artifact from the XAES and deliver it to Elizaveta Rysina, the Head of the City Council.

The saboteurs have made their demands. They want prisoners released, the siege of Tensess Temple to be lifted, a chest of gold, and lots of other goodies.
Unfortunately, their demands are not just based on idle threats. As soon as the enemy seized the plant we shut down the Astral pipeline, but the plant itself has huge Astral reserves and if it blows... well, there wouldn't be much left of the capital, let alone this camp.
Yasker's policy is to not negotiate with saboteurs. That can only mean one thing - we have to launch a covert operation to neutralize the threat, and you'll be the one taking it on. Yes, you!
Oh, and the most important thing... let's move away, for what I'm about to say is for your ears only. Nezeb's Staff, the saboteurs, saving the city... they're not our main priority.
Don't look at me like that! Why do you think the XAES is secret? You think it's just a large power plant? No! Not at all! There's an artifact in the center of it. Its purpose is not your business, nor mine, but rescuing it is a matter of life and death!
Please say the operation went smoothly, please! If that artifact is lost, Yasker won't let me hear the end of it!

Thank Nezeb! A great weight has been lifted from my shoulders!
Just remember, don't tell anyone about the artifact! Forget you ever heard of it or ever touched it! Fortunately the League doesn't know anything about our search, or the saboteurs would have seized it themselves! Fools! They started a massive operation to capture Nezeb's Staff but ignored the source of far greater power!
This is for you as a reward for your heroism and as a guarantee of your silence. Understood?
Collect 3 Tablets of Tep and bring them to Negus Kheket, the Head Scientist of the Arisen.

It is a gross injustice that the first explorer of the ruins beneath the Boiler Camp, which have stood untouched for more than three millennia, is going to be some adventurer like you and not a scientist!
Did you know that Tep himself could have resided in those very catacombs? That's important history we're talking about! Please tread carefully on the ancient floor and try not to break anything.
Damn, I can imagine what damage you'll do while fighting off the followers of Tep. Could you at least collect some artifacts along the way? Negus Kheket, the Head Scientist of the Arisen, says there should be some important tablets in there. They might even enable us to answer the ultimate question - is Tep still alive? Bring them to her if you find them. She's located in Yasker's Tower.

Damnit all to hell! I can imagine what those catacombs are going to look like after the operation is finished. There won't be anything left of them, it will all be destroyed!
And most importantly, the Tablets of Tep, which record all of his greatness and madness in equal measure, will be gone forever!

The Tablets!
This must be one of those rare situations where my predictions have proved to be wrong!
Here, take this as a reward for your respect of the Arisen heritage. I hope this isn't the end of our cooperation, for I feel that you could serve my people well in the future.
Kill 4 Tep Converts and report to Negus Kheket in Yasker's Tower.

There's one more thing I must tell you before you make your way to the catacombs. I have determined that it is in both of our best interests that you exterminate as many followers of Tep as you can.
Believe me when I say that we law-abiding Arisen are ashamed of Tep's crazed followers. We regard it as our mission to scour them from the Empire, and we are grateful for any help we can get.
Also, as soon as they're cleared out we can begin sending teams of scientists to examine what's left of the catacombs. Killing them will help you survive your mission too, of course.
In other words, Negus Kheket, the Head Scientist of the Arisen, would be grateful to you if you eliminated the followers of Tep. If you complete this mission, I suggest you report your success to her yourself. She's located in Yasker's Tower, and she's guaranteed to give you a reward.

Thousands of years ago Tep split our people into two factions - his followers, and his enemies.
Thousands of years have passed, and still things remain the same!
It's such a pity. All of those that you killed could have been on our side, but they chose Tep! Well, I suppose they got their just reward!
Kill 10 League soldiers and 8 goblins and report to Wrokag the Northwind.

Stay back, you bastard! You won't take me alive!! Oh, you're from the Empire! How did you get here? Have you got any others to help you? Only a few?! Are you planning to deal with all the saboteurs by yourselves?! Impressive...
Me, I got beat up pretty badly. I crawled over here to die in peace, but then you showed up. Looks like it's still too early to die! I'll show these bastards how a real Orc goes out! ...Damn, I can't move. It looks like you'll have to go on your own after all.
There shouldn't be too many of them left. Me and the boys managed to take down a fair share of them, but there will be enough left over for you as well. Kill them all! Every last one of them!! And inform Wrokag of what you accomplish, so that he knows that we have had our vengeance!
Each drop of Orcish blood must be paid for with gallons of the enemy's blood! Wow... That's a good line. I ought to remember it for future speeches.
You have avenged our brothers? Well, that deserves a reward!
Kill Grym the Gloomy and report back to Wrokag the Northwind.

Listen! I've got a personal favor to ask of you...
It concerns Grym the Gloomy, an engineer at the XAES. I remember when he was promoted to chief engineer, how he was hailed like a hero. There were articles about him in the papers, you know. They called him one of the most accomplished goblins in the Empire. It just shows you that in our country, even a goblin can get promoted at one of our most important institutions. But I never trusted him. He seemed way too shady for his own good. His eyes spent too much time wandering around the plant, and too little time on his assigned job.
And I was proven right! It turns out he's the main traitor in this debacle. He's a dangerous snake, I tell you!
He needs to be punished, once and for all. His fate should serve as a warning to others. Can you manage that?
Hmm, there's something very wrong in the Empire when we've got saboteurs operating right under our very noses! This isn't good at all...
What? You already took care of it? That's great, that's the way we like to do things around here! Punishment must be swift and harsh! It keeps the Empire the most orderly nation in history!
Prevent Yasker from being assassinated by defeating Afanasy Kudenov.

It's over! We're dead! And it's not my fault!! It's my treacherous relatives I tell you. I have always been loyal to the Empire!
The saboteurs got in here and they restored Nezeb's Staff. They were lead by a murderous Kanian wizard named Afanasy Kudenov. There's so much Astral energy here, so much magic... I'm sure that's what they used to restore it. And now it's a deadly weapon, so deadly that even Yasker won't be able to stop them!
They're planning on using some sort of portal charged by the Staff to reach Yasker's Tower. Once they get there I'm sure they're gonna kill him! Maybe they already have... argh! Then that'll spell the end of the Empire! You have to do something, go stop them!
Who are you? Who gave you permission to enter my office?

Ah, so that's what the whole operation was about. It was an attempt on my life! I suppose that's quite flattering. Great Nezeb, it looks like I have almost reached your level. I'm still surprised that Aidenus himself sanctioned such sabotage.
And you, it seems, are my savior. Hmm, not a bad start for your career. Let me personally reward you with one of the finest weapons in the Empire.
Use the Holy Water to cleanse 3 Cursed Zem Tombs and report to Thunder the Crafty.

My name is Thunder the Crafty of the City Council! I represent the authority here. You must be the Imperial Survivor. You wish to assist the Council? Have you been authorized to risk your life? Alright!
There are many cultists of Tep among the Arisen. Most of them are hiding in the Dusty Catacombs.
But they're not the only danger out there. Some tombs have been cursed with powerful necromantic spells that turn nearby undead into mindless killing machines. Simply destroying the monsters is pointless. We need to deal with the underlying cause and remove those curses.
Take this holy water and sprinkle it on 3 tombs. That should cleanse any dark magic from them.

I've encountered these cultists before and it's always the same dirty tricks and general nastiness. I wish we could find out if their overlord Tep was still alive. We'll have to settle for killing off their minions for now though.

Helping the authorities is a wise move on your part. I'll tell the right people that you've helped me today. Perhaps you'll be given even more important missions in the near future. I hope you realize what a great honor that would be!
Kill Bottomless Maw and report to Yaver Mbizi.

Had you decided to talk to some of those imbeciles that work for me, you would have heard a lot of scary stories. But the most amazing thing is that almost all of them are true.
Giant mutant rats? True. The ghost of the lost plumber? True. And the story of Bottomless Maw - well that is the most horrible truth of all.
Bottomless Maw is a giant crocodile that lives in the underground reservoir. They say he's over a thousand years old. I would never have believed this story myself if I hadn't seen the beast with my own eyes.
But the croc is just another excuse for slackers who don't want to work! They say they're afraid, that they want to live, blah blah blah. It's time this monster was finally killed, if only to silence the panic-mongers who are refusing to work. Can you handle this job?
They say there's an entrance down there that leads to his lair. When you find it, kill Bottomless Maw and return to me. I'll pay you back handsomely, I swear on my late mother's health!
I bet this giant crocodile is just another victim of Astral-induced mutations. A victim of progress!

All done?! Wow, this is great! I was right to count on you. Now we can go swimming again.
Way to go, Imperial Survivor! The nickname fits you well.
Collect 3 Crocodile Eggs and report back to Yana Vezirova.

I understand you are the Imperial Survivor. That's good, because I need to talk to you.
I work for the City Council and they are interested in studying a strange creature that lives on the bottom of the underground reservoir. Superstitious townsfolk gave the beast a gruesome name - they call him "Bottomless Maw".
This is just a simple crocodile that has undergone mutations caused by exposure to the Astral, causing him to increase in size. Those mutations are the only thing that make him so interesting.
The previous pilgrim whom I asked to investigate this beast pulled himself together and snuck into Bottomless Maw's lair. There he found out that the croc is not a he, but a she! And she's expecting offspring - her entire lair is filled with eggs. Those are what the Council is after.
Go to the underground reservoir, find Bottomless Maw's lair, and get those eggs. Then I'll forward them to the Council to be studied. Are you ready to serve your country once again?
You want to know what the Council plans to do with the crocodile eggs? Well, that's none of your business. Your job is to simply carry out their orders.

Wonderful! We've managed to get them just in time - just a little longer and instead of one Bottomless Maw, we would have had an entire army of mutant crocodiles to deal with!
Then we would have had to call in the special forces to handle this situation. I'm glad we managed to handle this on our own. Thanks for your service, pilgrim!
Kill 4 Giant Termites and return to Marta Kazakova.

Let me take a good look at you, the "Imperial survivor"...

Hmm... What is it, then? What makes you unique? Yes, unique. You are the first Imperial who used the teleporter and survived. Now we need to understand how it happened. They are going to announce that our Rescue Project has been a success. But honestly, we are still far away from success. You and I might be able to figure this out.

The most probable explanation is that the portal went off because it was near you for a fairly long time. It became attuned to you! We need to confirm this hypothesis or prove it wrong.

Here is a magical artifact. It's a copy of the teleporter that pulled you out of the Astral. Carry the teleporter with you, it needs time to attune itself to you. Shouldn't take long!

For starters, go to the slums where the giant termites live. You can find a lot of them in the Old Square. After you kill four termites, try to activate the teleporter and come right back here. I hope it works... I'll be looking forward to your return.

If I'm right and extensive adjustments are needed in order to make use of the teleportation device, the entire project may be in trouble...
I hope we don't lose our financing!
That took you a while! I was expecting you to materialize out of thin air, and here you are walking back! The teleporter didn't work?
Activate the teleporter, travel to Hadron Quarter, and speak with Yasskul Isis.

Interesting...

I felt a response when I was setting up your teleporter... If you use it, it will teleport you to an office of ZIT Headquarters. Find Yasskul Isis there, she will tell you what to do. But the stone is inactive right now - I'll activate it after you complete the tasks from Yana Vezirova and Pavel Bogdanov. But they might not give you any tasks - if you still have unfinished quests at the Old Square. One district after another!
Are you still here? You don’t want to help your fatherland? Or are you just gaping about?
Right, you're just what we need. Marta's report said you're willing to work for the good of the Imperial science. Here's your equipment. Shall we start?
Find the first and the second goblin encampments and report to Semyon Shishkin.

Hello! Would you like to work for the good of the Empire? I am a cartographer, and I'm putting together a detailed map of the city. Lately my work has come to a halt because of those goblins! The scoundrels are very cheeky - asking me for money for a city "pass" and threatening me.
Someone recommended that I talk with the "Black Hyenas" to solve this problem, claiming they'd be able to remove those jokers from my territory. Unfortunately, those bandits aren't much different from our bureaucrats - they're incredibly lazy!
They said to me, "You're a cartographer, you make maps, so give us a map showing where the goblins are and we'll eliminate them". Can you believe that?!
Let's do it like this - you walk around the neighborhood and find these goblins. Remember where their encampments are, tell me, and I will put them down on the map. Then I can give it to the Black Hyenas. They say that there are two groups of goblins operating here. Now go find them for me please.

Just look at what they did to the city! There's no escape from the goblins. It's time, oh yes, it's time to carry out a proper extermination and remove those nuisances from our capital once and for all!
Thank you! I'll give this information to the Black Hyena Leader as soon as possible. Then they'll show those goblins who the boss is!
Eliminate the Tep Berserkers and report to Ivan Korystin at the Hadron Quarter.

While the bugs are gathering data, I have an urgent task from the City Council for you.

Tep's main forces are hiding in the Dusty Catacombs. You can find the entrance at the digs.

We know they have leaders. And we paid for this information in blood.

We need to take out at least one leader - perhaps their death will play into our hands, or maybe the cultists will rally even more. However, this action will be primarily a demonstration - we must show that no one can kill the employees of the City Council and get away with it.
Has it been taken care of?

Are you done with the task? Excellent!
I have new information about the bugs!
Collect 4 pieces of Crow Meat and bring them to Grok the Bloodthirsty.

Hey, look over here! That's right, these are Gibberlings! Dance, you three-headed bastard, entertain the crowd!
...Nobody wants to see these damn Gibberlings. Maybe I should hand them over to the boys in Izune and let them have a little fun?
I thought Gibberlings would be a novelty here in Nezebgrad, and I figured that was bound to bring in the crowds! Hah! Now if I could get a demon, that would make me some serious cash!
These miserable bastards won't even eat anything. They'll probably die soon. I've offered them all sorts of things - rats, spiders, worms, but they won't eat them.
Listen, help me out, will you? I saw a few crows flying around here and I figure maybe these guys will eat their meat. What? If I were hungry, I'd eat some nastier things than crow meat, believe you me!
Did you get the meat? These Gibberlings look like they might keel over any minute from hunger...

Here it is! C'mon you worthless fur balls, dinner's ready.
...You have to cook it? Gibberlings won't eat raw meat? Hmm, that's strange... I mean, goblins don't have a problem with it. Perhaps you're right about cooking it... I could do with a manual on how to care for these damn things!
Collect Heavy Pine Cones at the Imperial Square for Reva the Roughneck.

Go warriors! Go warriors, go warriors!

Hello! Why the long face? No ticket? Well, you should plan ahead next time!

What? You don't know about the tournament? How is that possible? A Goblinball tournament is going to take place in the Wild Isles in the new stadium this week. The best teams will come together to compete! I can't wait!

I'm the head cheerleader, and we're supporting our fellas, the warriors! They'll show those ridiculous shamans who the real Orcs are! We've got a little problem though - according to the new rules, fans can't take any weapons into the stadium. We tried to protest, of course. But the officials said the orders came right from the top!

There's a solution, though. See those pine trees near Yasker's Tower? Their cones are real heavy. Get it?

If you want to help our team, bring me four heavy pine cones. I'll throw them at the shaman players, and every time one hits home, you'll know you've played your part in our victory! That's how you can participate.
'Shamans suck, warriors rule!' Good slogan, eh? I just came up with it myself. So, did you bring the cones?

Excellent! We've got over a thousand cones now. That's right, you're not the only one going around shaking pine trees. We've got tons of volunteers collecting cones! We'll bury the shamans with these things!
Find the Power Plant Blueprints and bring them to Victor Mozarov.

Forgive me for intruding and distracting you from important business. Things are in such a mess that nobody has time for my little problem.
Although now that I think about it, it's really not a little problem at all. You see, blueprints were made for the planned modernization of the entire XAES. The plant's magical capacity is already insufficient and the needs of the city grow every day. These blueprints could tell the enemy a lot about the principles used to construct the power plant.
And... well... a League saboteur got them. I saw him grab a whole pile of papers from my desk. I don't know his name, he didn't stop to introduce himself.
If you can find those designs in the course of your other missions, there would be no limit to my gratitude! Please keep an eye out for them!
How's it going? Have you found the designs? I might have a problem or two if they remain in the hands of the enemy.

Thank you so much! Phew! That's a weight off my shoulders alright. My wife nearly drove herself mad packing our things. We thought we'd be driven out of Nezebgrad for my mistake! My family is forever in your debt.
Bring 4 pieces of Giant Spider Web to Vera Chonkina in the Astral Quarter.

Attention, attention!

Citizens of Nezebgrad and visitors to the capital! You can help us achieve our common goal and bring the Empire closer to the moment of victory over the treacherous League!

I hereby announce a voluntary work event. Today's objective is the collection of spider web around the Mana Station. Imperial scientists have discovered the surprising medicinal properties of the web. We can use it to heal the wounds of our valorous soldiers on the field of battle. Every piece of spider web is another one of our warriors saved, another enemy annihilated! Show your patriotism, hunt those spiders, and bring me their web! Each contribution will help the Imperial Army tremendously.

I repeat...

Attention, attention!
Citizens of Nezebgrad and visitors to the capital! You can help further our common goal and accelerate the Empire's victory over the treacherous League here and now!
I hereby announce a voluntary work event... Damn, my throat is dry. I wonder if I'll be able to keep this up all day.

Thank you. Your contribution to our common cause will make a real difference. Allow me to record your name for my report...
Attention, attention! Citizens of Nezebgrad and visitors to the capital! I am proud to announce that the Imperial Survivor is here, helping with our voluntary work event. That's a real patriot for you!
Kill 4 Voracious Rats at the Bort Quarter. Report to Timur Korobkin.

Damn the day I agreed to become the supervisor of these warehouses! I get complaints all the time!
 Nothing but complaints. All day long. One guy says rats ate a hat his grandma made for him, and another reckons they ate his iron slabs. What a liar! Thieves! He probably sold them at the auction house and now he wants to blame it on the rats. The trouble is, I can't argue because we really do have a rat infestation. They'll eat anything they can get their dirty little teeth on.
If only we could all join forces and eliminate the rats once and for all... All it would take is for every citizen to kill just a few, and they'd be gone! Let's start with you!
Kill four rats for me. There are plenty of people hanging around the Bort Quarter but no one wants to help.

I sent three to the warehouse. Good... Which means 15 dead rats...
That's Xadaganian wit for you!
Thank you! That's civilian mobilization for you. Nobody slacking, everyone fighting the rats. That's the only way a great country can be made!
Bring 3 Bottles of Elven Wine to Thunder the Crafty at ZIT Headquarters.

Oh, my head...

I think I overdid it last night... We were celebrating the Day of the City Council. I slept in, so I'm late for work! My boss will have my guts for garters!

At the moment I'm stationed in the Hadron Quarter. I'm supposed to protect the citizens from the cultists that are occupying the ancient catacombs. My commander is waiting for me there... Damn it! How can I show up like this?

Wait, he was celebrating with us last night! Which means he must have a hangover, too. I've got an idea. I'll bring him something to smooth things over, and he'll let this slide.

I've heard that a lot of smuggled goods have been brought into the city lately. I bet those thugs have got some good stuff, maybe even some Elven wine! It's really expensive! And hard to come by. I'd like to get my hands on a few bottles for Thunder the Crafty.

Help me out? Can you get three bottles and bring them to my boss, Thunder the Crafty? I'd do it myself, but with my head the way it is, I can't be chasing after contraband. Now where can you find it? I hear a few boxes are hidden around the Hadron Quarter. The smugglers usually hide them in alleyways and bushes. Can you do that?
What is it? I'm very busy!

Is that for me? From Burkin? I see...
Listen to me very carefully, Imperial Survivor. I am an employee of the City Council. The Council members have cool minds, passionate hearts, and clean hands! Do you get my meaning?
I will forgive you this time, but I'm confiscating this contraband wine. I'll deal with Burkin myself once he shows up. You'd do well to remember that you can never bribe a real Council member.
Bring the Abandoned Chest to Feodor Preminin.

Nezebgrad has gone, gone I tell you! The city gets worse every day. What have they done to our capital, those beasts?
Have you heard about the 'An Apartment for Every Imperial Soldier' campaign? It's a good initiative, but what's become of it? I'm a veteran of the Great Astral Campaign, and I'm being forced out of my own home!
It's now being occupied by Orcs - the entire neighborhood is turning Orc! Meanwhile, the Council hasn't given me a new place yet - there's a delay with the paperwork. Those bastards!
I could cope if that was it - after all, we're used to hardships. But then some Orcs attacked me! They're nothing more than thugs and scumbags! They've taken over my apartment and now they won't even let me get my things. Those bastards!
Will you help me? My home is to the north of here. Near the front of the building is a chest filled with my possessions which those scumbags threw into the yard. I'm afraid of going back there myself. I'm not as strong as I once was. If you bring me my chest, I'll be eternally grateful!
Everything that I worked so hard to earn is in that chest! My veteran's overcoat, my silver cigarette case... everything!

Thank you! Everything is starting to work out now. I've gotten my chest back and I've finally been given a new apartment too. It's even a bit bigger than the old one. Let the Orcs live in those slums - that's what they deserve! There will be more room for distinguished citizens like myself in the newer neighborhoods.
Return the Ceremonial Dagger to Marat Yesenin.

Oh dear, I've got a problem here... I was invited to work in the capital as the winner of the Police Officer's National Singing Championship. It was supposed to be a promotion, but what kind of promotion can you call being sent to the worst district of Nezebgrad?
You should have seen how I was attacked by those Orcs. They beat me up and stole my ceremonial dagger, which was given to me as an award for winning the singing competition! Those scoundrels! Their leader was called Brentback the Crafty - he was a real thug.
So here I am, standing in the street and wondering what to do next. I can't tell my new coworkers - they'll just laugh at me. Everyone's already laughing at me, asking me to sing. If I tell them about this...
Can you help me? You're the Imperial Survivor, aren't you? They say that you're the only one who emerged unscathed from the Kanian ambush! I'm sure you could beat them. Help me get my dagger back.
That dagger is very dear to me. I hope you can find it.

Yes, that's it! Oh dear, they've already managed to scratch it and blunt the blade. I hope they didn't use my little dagger for any shady business.
How can I thank you? Would you like me to sing for you? I could sing you my favorite victory song! 'Our service is dangerous and tough! And while at first it goes unnoticed...'
Fix 3 broken bushes in the Victory Park. Report to Rodion Verigin.

Has everyone gone mad? They've only just opened the park, the orchestra has only just started to play... and already a horde of investigators from the Council has turned up!
They're searching everyone, measuring the staff on the statue of Nezeb, sniffing around here, poking around there... They won't even say what the fuss is about. You don't know, do you?
Hmm, oh well, never mind. It's beyond me. My job is to make sure that the flowers are in bloom, the air is fragrant, and that everything is pleasing to behold. It's just a shame that we have to put up with all these investigators. They've broken all the bushes!
You have some time to help me out, right? I can give you some rope to tie the broken bushes together. Can you do that?
What a day the grand opening was! The whole city came out to help plant the bushes. It was a joy to behold!
What a difference! The park looks more like a park again and not like the Sewage Plant. Thank you!
Kill 4 Goblin Thieves around the port and return to Yasskul Userhet.

My name is Yasskul Userhet.
Do you know what "Yasskul" means? It's a scientific title. All Arisen with the titles "Semer", "Sarang", "Yaver" or "Sarbaz" are junior scientific officers. The title "Yasskul", on the other hand, must be earned. Only "Negus" is above me. And we have only one Nefer - Nefer Ur, our leader.
It was only a short time ago that I was waving goodbye to a ship that was carrying Nefer Ur to the Holy Land. He was heading on a secret mission. As he was leaving, he noticed a huge number of goblins near the port - vagabonds, pickpockets, and thieves. And do you know what he did?
He said, "What a mess!" and then sailed away. Since Nefer Ur said so, we must fix this!
You can find these pesky little monsters all over the city. But personally I'm only interested in the ones that live in the area I'm responsible for - the port.
So get to work. Clean out the goblins from my sight!
I would really like it if, upon his return, Nefer Ur would see Nezebgrad cleansed of all the dirt. Then he would come to me and say, "Well done Yasskul Userhet!"
Thank you! You'll see, when I earn the rank of Negus and become the right hand of Nefer Ur, I will reward you!
Kill 3 Steppe Spiders and Widixa and report to Nezeb Proskurin. You can find the spiders to the west of Nezebgrad.

I am cursed with my name! My parents, being the true Imperial patriots that they were, named me after our great leader. Of course, a Xadaganian with such a name must live up to it and do great things! Especially after the disappearance of my illustrious namesake, may his name be blessed.
At first I pursued magical studies, aspiring to be a Great Mage. But soon afterwards Yasker, may he be blessed as well, passed a decree regarding the closure of elemental magic schools for Xadaganians. Apparently, the Arisen are now given top priority for training in the magical arts!
That's how I ended up where I am today - a Nezeb, but not a mage, a servant of the City Council, but of the lowest rank possible. And yet I am given responsibilities that are far beyond my station!
For example, gigantic spiders have appeared near Nezebgrad. Who is sent to solve this problem? Not the Sentinels, oh no. It's Nezeb Proskurin! The fact that they're huge and led by an enormous female which kills her own mates doesn't seem to make a bit of difference.
Can you go and do it? I'm scared to even go outside the city walls at the thought of those terrifying beasts! Please...?
Why does everyone else have normal names! Pavel, Alexey, Mikhail... But me - I am Nezeb! How can I live like this?

Really?! Wow, I envy your strength. Hey, maybe I should start my life again? Assume a new name, board the first ship I see, and go to some exotic place.
It's tempting, but as soon as I go to change my name I'm sure I'll get dragged before the Council. "And what is this, citizen Nezeb? You don't like the name of our great leader?" What can you say to that?
Go to the Astral Quarter and pass on Fiercetusk's ultimatum to Squall.

Now you're one of us! But there's no time to chat. And here's an amulet for you. We give it to everyone who is worthy.

Ready for your first task?

Go to the Astral Quarter and find Squall the Unyielding - he's the head of the local Orcs. And give him my ul... ulti... ul-ti-ma-tum! There!

I was never schooled properly, so you'd better write this down!

Tell him he's an old goat, and that he'll be dead along with the rest of the shamans!
Now the warriors are going to lead the Orcs. His time is over. If he's a coward who prefers to die in a soft bed rather than on a battlefield - then he should surrender and pass authority to me! But I hope he's still an orc, and that he'll agree to an honest battle. My boys are bored and would love a good fight.

Well, that's my ultimatum. I'm sure Squall the Unyielding will accept the challenge.

Do you have something to report?
What?! A message from Fiercetusk the Roughneck? Speak now!
Kill 3 Steppe Termites and a Plain Termite and report to Yaver Meresankh.

Stop! Do you want to serve the Empire? My name is Yaver Meresankh, and I am a sanitation worker. What's that? No, it's not a very glorious job, but it's very important I assure you! And I'm the best cleaner there is - I even have a certificate to prove it!
Anyway, I was sent here to clean up after a termite invasion. The only problem is, there are still tons of termites outside the base just waiting to make a mess of our buildings again! They need to be eliminated.
I will tell you without any false modesty - the termites in the city are puppies in comparison to the huge insects that we get around here. This is a task for real warriors, not some milksops.
So, will you help me out here? I can't promise you any large reward or personalized weaponry, but this is a great opportunity to help the Empire. Well?
I can't tell you how much poison we've put out to kill those things. It's no use at all!
Well done! You truly are a great citizen. I wish we had more like you! If everyone was in their place, doing their jobs, the Empire would be unstoppable!
Kill 4 Steppe Vultures and report to Farstride the Nomadic.

I suffocate when I'm in towns - I just can't do it! My soul wants open spaces, open skies, and freedom! Ah! I'm from the wilds. It's not a clan, it's a way of life.
The Orcs that don't want to become brutes or shamans or reavers become marauders, like me! We're our own bosses. We can go where we want and work for whomever we want to. At the moment I work for the City Council. I've been sent here to kill vultures so they don't wander into the city.
This is the kind of life I like - hunting beasts under the open sky where I can breathe easily. Let's do it together! I'm sure you'll see what a great lifestyle it is!
I've already shot a couple dozen vultures. How are you doing?

Hah, not too bad! Don't think I want to partner up with you for good - I'm a solitary soul. I might take off tomorrow and go somewhere far, far away if it suits me - maybe hunt some tigers in the Holy Land. That's the sort of life for me!
Travel to the small allod using the Adventurer's Stone and touch the ancient June ruins.

The Adventurer's Stone, which is now tuned to you, can detect magical pathways between the ancient June ruins. It is also capable of transporting you between them by tapping into that magic.
For a long time, we have been faced with the problem of moving quickly between neighboring allods. First we tried training Astral animals to be carriers, and when that failed we built ships. While the ships are safe enough, they aren't as fast we'd like. The Stone, however, is capable of moving a person safely and quickly between their destinations.
You will become the world's first Astralnaut by journeying through the Astral using only the power of the Stone. There is a small allod not too far from here where more ancient June ruins are located. It also stores the memory of the ancient teleportation network. Once you activate the power of the ruins that are next to me, you will be dragged through the Astral and to that allod's ruins. After you arrive, simply touch the allod's ruins and it will create a magical impulse that will teleport you back to me.
Do you understand your mission? If everything goes as planned, this will finally mark the end of Project Salvation!
I wonder if this will work. I don't particularly want to write a report explaining the death of the first Astralnaut.

You're here! That means that everything worked properly. Excellent!
The Adventurer's Stone is yours by right now. We are planning to mass produce them and supply the Stones to the entire Imperial population. I wonder if we should write a handbook outlining the rules of safe Astral travel...
In any case, well done! You are officially the first Astralnaut. I'm sure that someday there will be a city named after you. Be proud!

t: Talk to Sarbaz Raemka at the Nezebgrad Port.

I have been studying Marta's report, and it looks like she missed something.

I'm not surprised! You need more than just a degree from our Research Institute to understand all the intricacies of this apparatus! No, first you have to die from a horrible plague, spend a couple thousand years in the grave, be resurrected - and then you can say you have enough experience to go with your intuition!

Let me tell you a story. Our whole world is permeated with magic, and way back in the era of the June civilization, the art of teleportation was developed using that magical energy. There are ruins of their ancient portals everywhere. This instrument, which Marta calls "Teleporter", used to be called something entirely different - an "Adventurer's Stone".

And to reward you for everything you've done, I'll let you be the first to test its secret abilities.

Go to the Nezebgrad Port north of Nezebgrad. Find the scientist named Sarbaz Raemka, and tell him you will test the Adventurer's Stone. He'll tell you what to do.
Are you from Yasskul Isis? Well then, I've got everything ready. Let's start!

t: Fight on behalf of the shamans and defeat the leader of the warriors' duelists. When you are victorious, report to Feather the Thicket.

Do you want to fight on the side of the shamans? Ha, I knew you were the type to do anything for victory!
Your job is to kill the leader of the warriors. Simple, isn't it? Do that, and victory is yours. Just remember that he will try to kill you as well...
If you take him down, talk with my assistant. She will put your name on the list of champions.
Another battle, isn't that great? But despite our ways, the Orcs are one of the oldest races in the world!
Congratulations! Let me get your name on the list of champions. Thanks to you the score is 756:755 in favor of the shamans!
Fight on behalf of the warriors and defeat the leader of the shamans' duelists. When you are victorious, report to Feather the Thicket.

Do you want to fight on the side of the warriors? Ha, I knew you were the type that couldn't resist the call of battle!
Your job is to kill the leader of the shamans. Simple, isn't it? Do that, and victory is yours. Just remember that he will try to kill you as well...
If you take him down, talk with my assistant. She will put your name on the list of champions.
